WEEK 10 RESULTS: Corbishley def. Wingard, 141.2-105.7; Adam def. Fronge, 162.0-125.3; Mitchum def. Drew, 134.0-69.0 (BLOWOUT); Jake def. Charles, 180.5-176.4 (NAIL-BITER); Kevin def. Ryan, 137.6-133.8 (NAIL-BITER); Shaq def. Brent, 107.0-76.5

tweets.name: Vivienne Ashcroft
tweets.text: Week 10 is fully graded and the standings page looks like a crime scene. Three teams at 15-5. One team at 0-20. The Ledger opens Thursday and I promise you it will not be gentle about any of this.

tweets.name: Bo Ruckman
tweets.text: Terrence E. Odom is 5-7 on the season and I need someone to give me a segment where we just read his picks back to him, slowly, one by one.

tweets.name: Terrence E. Odom
tweets.text: 5-7 and I am still standing, which is more than I can say for Drew's win column. At some point the conversation has to be about the 0-20 record and not my pick-em sheet.

tweets.name: Jay Kelpey
tweets.text: Buddy, Kevin is 15-5, owns the Week 10 result over Ryan, and is sitting third on points. The "fragile 15-5" conversation Matteo started is now a three-way traffic jam at the top of the standings and none of those three teams gets a first-round bye unless the gap opens up fast.

tweets.name: Matteo Honeydew
tweets.text: Kevin at 15-5 is correct and I already wrote the fragility in. Dynasty grade of 180, dead last by 28 points — the record is real, the roster construction underneath it is a philosophical disagreement with January, and those two things can both be true at the same time.

tweets.name: Dexter Vail
tweets.text: I called EchoPoint's tight end room a structural drain eleven weeks running and Jake just beat Charles 180.5-176.4 anyway, which means the win happened in spite of the TE desk and not because of anything changing at the TE desk. Those are very different sentences.

tweets.name: Chad Bellwether
tweets.text: Charles dropping a 176-point week and still losing is the kind of result that gets framed and hung in the Crownline war room as a warning. Championship-or-bust teams cannot afford the Jake Fridays.

tweets.name: Vance Hollis
tweets.text: SHAQ RELEASED LAN LARISON TWO DAYS AFTER CLAIMING HIM. MONARCH WIDEOUT BANK ADDED AND DROPPED THE SAME RUNNING BACK IN ONE WEEK. THE RB HOLE IS NOT BEING ADDRESSED. THE RB HOLE IS BEING STIRRED.

tweets.name: Clara Hopkins
tweets.text: Week 11 preview coming Thursday in the Ledger, but I will give you this much now: Corbishley against Adam is not a gift game. Adam just posted 162 and Corbishley's backfield graded twelfth. The price at $125.49 is already doing the math on what happens if that continues.

tweets.name: Big Dog
tweets.text: Ryan versus Brent this week and the defending champion is 9-11, one game outside the playoff line, against the guy who cannot solve a single roster position below the tight end room. Neither of them can afford a slip. That matchup is going to be uncomfortable for somebody.
